body: First CI run after the repo went public: Linux green; macOS 2 timeouts; Windows cli tests fail because GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=devNull is unreadable by git for Windows. Then fix any Windows bugs the real runs show.

completion.summary: CI green on all OSes (run 42769592689): temp gitconfig, 30s timeouts in CI, named pipes in socket tests, POSIX test fixes, git kept on PATH in init tests. New finding recorded: init goes standalone when git cannot run.

title: Make CI green on Windows and macOS runners
